name: Swanson Sipping Bone Broth (Chicken with Ginger & Turmeric)
whyItWorks: Pre-packaged microwavable sipping cup delivering 8g collagen protein with anti-inflammatory turmeric and ginger. 100% liquid with zero fiber or solid chunks; perfect for travel and desk warming.
